//: The wanderer's field guide: read it to see the card for the level you are on. Survival Difficulty Classes come from the Backrooms Wiki's rating system (0 safest, 5 deadliest); the wording here is our own.
description: A fat little notebook held shut with a rubber band, passed from hand to hand by people who got lost before you.  Every level anyone came back from has a page: what it's like, what lives there, and a rating someone underlined twice, Class 0 for safe up to Class 5 for don't.  Read it to look up the level you're on.

use_action.description: Read the page for the level you're on.

//: Run on arrival at a level (the travel EOCs and the scenario starts call it). The first visit to each level shows its full card as a popup; later visits only log the class.

then.u_message: Level 1, "the Parking Deck".  Survival Difficulty: Class 1.
Level 2, "the Pipe Tunnels".  Survival Difficulty: Class 3.

//: Reading the field guide: the full card for the level you are on.

else.u_message: You leaf through every page.  None of them describe this place.  Someone has written on the inside cover: <color_red>if it isn't in here, you're the first.</color>

effect.u_message:
<color_yellow>LEVEL 0: "THE LOBBY"</color>
<color_light_green>Survival Difficulty: Class 1</color>
- Safe.
- Secure.
- Few entities.

Mono-yellow rooms that go on forever, damp carpet, and the hum of the lights.  Most of what walks here fell in from outside like you did: the dead, strays, and the odd wild animal.  The Backrooms' own things are rare this close to the edge, but not unheard of.

<color_white>Expect:</color> scavenging from old offices and storerooms, long walks with no landmarks, and the feeling that the rooms rearrange themselves when you aren't looking.

<color_yellow>LEVEL 1: "THE PARKING DECK"</color>
<color_light_green>Survival Difficulty: Class 1</color>
- Safe.
- Secure.
- Anomalous resources.

An endless underground garage of concrete pillars, oil stains and dead cars.  People live here: the Breakroom keeps order, and squatter camps hold the corners.  Water is scarce and almond water scarcer.

<color_white>Expect:</color> Hounds hunting in packs, Deathmoths at the lights, and Smilers in any lobby that goes dark.  The lights flicker and some die for good.

<color_yellow>LEVEL 2: "THE PIPE TUNNELS"</color>
<color_red>Survival Difficulty: Class 3</color>
- Unsafe.
- Unstable.
- Moderate entity count.

Hot, cramped maintenance tunnels, packed with pipes, cables and machines that stopped working long ago.  Hardly anyone lives here any more.  Food is very rare.

<color_white>Expect:</color> more Hounds and Smilers than Level 1, long stretches with no light at all, and pipes that burst without warning and fill the tunnel with scalding steam.
